target.description: What to open: a file, the session diff, or a web page

path.description: File path, absolute or relative to the working directory. Required for "file"; for "diff", the file to jump to (omit for the whole diff)

line.description: "file" only: first line to scroll to and highlight (1-based)

end_line.description: "file" only: last line of the highlighted range (inclusive); needs line

url.description: "url" only: an absolute http or https URL, localhost included
